english.title: Possess a controlled drug of Class B - Ketamine
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) had in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of Ketamine, a controlled drug of class B in contravention of section 5(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
possess Ketamine a controlled drug of class B

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: From 10th June 2014 the classification of Ketamine changed from a Class C to a Class B controlled drug. Offences committed before this date should be charged under the 'Class C' code - MD71500 (H8365)
